text:
Martin Necas has 24 points in 19 games, after a 100-point season, and this fall he's been in the news off the ice too, joining other Czech NHL players in condemning a minister's remarks about women's hockey. On the ice, his game is a smooth fit beside Nathan MacKinnon.

The goals need an asterisk. He's shooting 25% (18% last season) on 5.8 expected goals, and Colorado has scored four more goals than expected with him on. Both will fade. Evolving-Hockey also flagged that he plays with the strongest teammates in the league by their impact, which flatters any winger on that line.

Still, he was 11th of 401 forwards in wins above replacement last season, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking has him carrying the puck in on 62% of his entries with a 95th percentile setup rate. Our range says 81 to 109 points.
